title: @workflow
description: a task graph under @workflow, compiled by workflow.jq to a net; that each need names a task, and that needs hold no cycle, are checked by the compile

tasks.description: each task by name, in declaration order

run.description: the target the task runs; without it, the task only passes its outcome on

needs.description: the tasks that must end before this one starts

when.description: which outcomes of its needs let it run: success when all succeeded, failed when any failed, done either way; otherwise it is skipped

over.description: items the task runs once per, each a label

pool.description: an open pool whose tokens bound the task's runs in flight
